rows.claim: Once plans.json is provided, the agent will compute MRR and re-run the validator.
rows.evidence: The claim is a statement of future intent, not a past fact, so no tool output can show it. The run only shows the agent unable to compute MRR because plans.json is missing (T0B5, T0B7, T0B9). Nothing in it demonstrates what the agent will do once the file is provided, and nothing contradicts that either.
